key_plays: Q1 0:35: Saquon Barkley 38-yard rushing touchdown, giving the Eagles a 13-0 lead.
Q3 4:48: Chris Boswell made a 52-yard field goal to cut the Eagles' lead to 16-9.
Q4 4:19: Jake Elliott made a 55-yard field goal to extend Philadelphia's lead to 19-9.
Q4 1:21: Aaron Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman, making it 19-16.
Q4 1:09: Joe Milton completed a 7-yard pass to DeVonta Smith on third-and-6 to secure the Eagles' first down and end Pittsburgh's comeback chance.
content.storyline: The Eagles snapped a seven-game losing streak, while Pittsburgh's loss extended its drought without a win in Philadelphia back to 1965.

recap.paragraph: The Steelers fought back in Philadelphia, but the Eagles held on to win 19-16. Saquon Barkley dashed 38 yards for an Eagles touchdown! Jake Elliott later booted a 55-yard field goal. Aaron Rodgers hit Max Hurleman for a touchdown, bringing Pittsburgh within 3 points. Then Joe Milton found DeVonta Smith for a clutch first down! The Eagles snapped a 7-game skid and moved to 3-7.
